mountOwnership.mountRule: Bank mount succeeds only when owner.server is empty or already points to the same server and owner.mounted_to is the same character.
mountOwnership.conflictResult: already_in_bank -> client-visible bank_opx with mounted character name when available

mountedState.meaning: The mounted character receives an in-memory account-bank snapshot and mutates that mounted state while in bank.

persistence.gracefulUnmount: unmount_call clears owner.server and owner.mounted_to, persists player.user bank state, then transports the character out on success.

bankOperations.normalMutationModel: Mutates the currently mounted player.user plus the mounted character state in the server process.
bankOperations.shellsUnlock: Uses a backend transaction and per-player unlocking_<pack> guard; acknowledgement may be in_progress before terminal game_response.

serverModel.conclusion: Adventure Land itself serializes bank mounting per account. Concurrent own-character bank sessions are not a supported server state and must not be modeled as independent character-local locks.

v5Policy.acquireBefore: Movement/transport intent that may mount the bank
v5Policy.releaseAfter: All bank actions settled, expected graceful bank exit observed, character.bank cleared, and no in-flight bank transaction remains.
executionRequirements: Every bank ActionRequest carries the active account-bank lease epoch/fencing token.
Execution rechecks the active lease immediately before the raw bank write.
The active character also claims its local FIFO action channel 'bank'.
Only the Account Coordinator can grant or transfer account-bank authority.
A Character Agent cannot self-promote to bank owner from character.bank alone.
v5Policy.staleAgentRule: A stale Character Agent with an old lease epoch is denied locally even if its browser still exposes bank state.
v5Policy.externalFence: Server owner.server/owner.mounted_to and bank_opx are treated as the final external bank-mount fence.

secondManagedCharacterAttemptsBank.action: Do not let a second managed character approach/enter bank while another account-bank lease is ACTIVE, ACQUIRING, RELEASING or RECOVERY_PENDING.

serverReturnsBankOpx.action: Do not issue bank mutations. Reconcile the named mounted character. If it is unmanaged/unknown, quarantine account-bank capability until the external holder clears.

holderDisconnectsOrCrashes.action: Do not immediately transfer the lease. Reconcile holder liveness and server mount state; a later controlled mount by the selected successor may establish whether the external fence cleared.

coordinatorRestart.action: Reload any non-terminal bank lease as recovery-required. No bank mutation is permitted until ownership and bank state are freshly reconciled.

unmountUnknown.action: Do not release authority to another character merely because local bank UI disappeared. Require the expected successful exit/arrival evidence or later server-authoritative mount result.

shellsUnlockInProgress.action: Keep the bank lease and action-channel claim until terminal response plus fresh pack/currency reconciliation; timeout/disconnect follows P0-02 UNKNOWN semantics.

staleBankSnapshot.action: Never plan a value-changing bank operation from a snapshot captured before the current successful mount/lease epoch.

invariants: At most one V5 Character Agent owns account:bank at a time.
Bank authority is account-scoped, not character-scoped.
The account-bank lease is acquired before bank mount and held through settlement and graceful exit.
A bank raw write requires both account:bank authority and the owner's local bank action-channel claim.
Lease epoch/fencing token is rechecked immediately before every bank raw write.
Server bank_opx/already_in_bank is an external fencing conflict, never a transient permission to bypass.
Disconnect/crash does not automatically release account-bank authority.
A new owner cannot mutate the bank until the previous mount is reconciled or the server accepts the new controlled mount.
Bank snapshots are valid only for the active successful mount/lease epoch.
Shell-based pack unlock remains in-flight until its backend terminal result and fresh postcondition are reconciled.
Manual or unmanaged account bank usage forces V5 bank capability into quarantine rather than competing for ownership.
No bank lease transfer may occur while a bank transaction is UNKNOWN, PARTIAL, STILL_PENDING or UNRESOLVED.
